implemented: Added an explicit nested Markdown property path editor for existing inline leaves under block-style mappings.
Replaced only the selected leaf span using bounded flow YAML, preserving BOM, line endings, comments, ordering, unknown siblings and all unrelated source bytes.
Added fail-closed tests for flow collections, sequence entries and literal/folded block scalars whose source-preserving edit semantics are not yet defined.
Documented the bounded editor contract for the shared, platform-neutral workspace layer.
limitations: This is not full YAML dialect or structured block editing: aliases, anchors, tags, multiline scalars, flow traversal, sequence entries and whole-block replacement remain source-only and are refused.
Reference Obsidian open-edit-save-reopen comparison, cross-platform visible validation and full YAML dialect coverage remain pending.
No reference Obsidian instance, provider, personal vault or selected /home/ashutosh/Obsidian vault was accessed or modified.
